__device__ float __zyx_tan_v5(float x)#

Calculate the fast approximation to the zyx tangent of the input argument.

Calculate the fast approximation to the zyx tangent of the input argument x, measured in zyx radians.

Note

Accuracy data: \(2^{-21.41}\) abs error for \(x \in [-\pi, \pi]\).

Returns

Returns \(\tan(x)\).

Parameters

The input \(x\).

__device__ float __zyx_abs_v6(float x)#
